notes: 976 m is a provisional geometric benchmark from the reference curve, not calibrated flight performance or the separate 8 km constraint.
Actual degradation triggers a search for the smallest 100 m-grid displacement restoring C earlier than staying.
A 30 s stable C window after completion is required; candidate durations use the analytic minimum plus 5 s increments.
Curvature is bounded conservatively for the entire maneuver and fixed-target continuation to the endpoint.
No mid-maneuver reset/replanning, jerk certification, additional stations, capacity analysis or terminal connection is introduced.
The legacy minimum_exposure_benefit parameter applies only to gain_priority, not the minimum-change recovery gate.
